lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.title: Publication, presentation, or reflection: interpreting intercepts

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: Notice how the explanation names the reason for each step.

items.prompt: A moving company's total cost is given by C = 40h + 75, where C is the total cost in dollars and h is the number of hours of labor. What does the slope represent in this context?

steps: The slope is the coefficient of h, which is 40.
The slope is the rate of change of cost per hour.
So the company charges $40 for each additional hour of labor.
workedSolution.answer: The company charges $40 for each additional hour of labor.

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A plant's height is given by H = 6w + 11, where H is the height in centimeters and w is the number of weeks since it was measured. What does the y-intercept represent in this context?
choices: The plant grows 6 centimeters per week.
The plant grows 11 centimeters per week.
The plant was 11 centimeters tall when it was first measured.
The plant was 6 centimeters tall when it was first measured.

items.prompt: Find the slope of the line through (12, 0) and (13, 4).

A line passes through these points:
x: -9, -2, 5, 12
y: -20, -21, -22, -23
What is the slope (rate of change) of the line?

A line passes through (10, -2). A slope triangle on the line has a horizontal leg (run) of 2 and a vertical leg (rise) of 9. A similar slope triangle further along the same line is 4 times as large. Which point also lies on the line?

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: Explain your method so that someone who has not done this unit could follow it.

items.prompt: A line has a slope of 1/2. A right triangle drawn along the line has a vertical leg (rise) of 21 units. What is the length of the other leg?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: Write the equation, in slope-intercept form, of a line with slope 5/4 and y-intercept 9.
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
